state_definition.P: exp(log p) = p (positive multiplicative scale state)
state_definition.E: exp(log e) = e (positive multiplicative scale state)

update_rule: Z_next = Z_current elementwise-multiplied by factors computed only from Z_current; no decoded/readout values are fed back

paper4_map_audit.note: these are dominated by floating-point unit-phase drift; theoretical phase factors are unit modulus

strict_literal_encoding_obstruction.interpretation: literal exp(p), exp(e) cannot evaluate the current RR/orbit formulas without log; p/e must be reparameterized or the state basis enlarged
